Produce only the flat FULL-BLEED square texture, NOT a room or sphere mockup. ONE large lovely relaxed anime eye, slightly right of center: iris center (57%,54%), opening from x=14% to 94%, upper lash arch near y=37%, lower rim near y=70%.
